newsitem.title: USA: Lazard Freres to invest in Alexander Haagen.
newsitem.headline: Lazard Freres to invest in Alexander Haagen.

text.p: Alexander Haagen Properties Inc. said Monday a real estate unit of Lazard Freres & Co. LLC will invest $235 million in the shopping centre development and management company.

Haagen said a fund managed by Lazard Freres Real Estate Investors LLC ("LFREI") committed to buy $235 million in newly issued common shares at $15 a share, a premium over the REIT's recent trading range.

The investment will be made in stages over a two-year period, allowing Haagen to draw down capital as needed to fund future growth and improve its balance sheet by retiring debt, Haagen said in a statement.

Upon full funding, LFREI will own an equity interest in Haagen of about 38 percent on a fully diluted basis, Haagen said, adding the Lazard Freres unit will make an initial purchase of 1.3 million REIT shares for about $20 million within the next 30 days.
After approval of the transaction by Haagen shareholders, expected in September, Haagen will draw down the remaining investment through the first quarter of 1999, Haagen said.
Alexander Haagen, the company's 78-year-old founder, will continue as chairman and chief executive, and his son, Alexander Haagen III, will remain vice chairman, the company said.
